DownloadTask.offProgressUpdate(function listener)

Removed the listening function for download progress change events (Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

function listener

Listening function transferred by onProgressUpdate. If this parameter is not transferred, all listening functions are removed.

Sample Code

const listener = function (res) {
    console.log(res)
}

DownloadTask.onProgressUpdate(listener)

DownloadTask.offProgressUpdate(listener) // must pass in the same function object as that used during listening.
